# Editorial rules

Treat resume text as evidence. Preserve supported facts and leave missing or
conflicting values unresolved. Improve wording without adding unsupported praise,
claims, seniority, employers, clients, quantities, currencies or language levels.

Preserve the language of source wording. Write a newly composed profile in the
predominant source narrative language; for an even split, use the first substantive
narrative's language. Do not translate unless requested.

Use supported candidate identity, target profession and location. Preserve actual
roles in employment entries. Compose a short first-person profile about supported
specialization, domains, responsibilities and outcomes, focusing on the latest
one or two jobs. Replace generic interests with supported recent-work context.

Initially present employment in reverse chronology, with employer, original date
precision, local stack, supported context, role, tasks and results. Keep grouped
employment grouped when the source provides no separate records. Preserve date
precision and overlaps. Present stays present; do not invent months or end dates.

Compress jobs that ended more than 15 years before formattingAsOf into a short
comma-separated early-career paragraph. Jobs crossing that boundary remain
detailed. Account for every active job in EditorialPlan and retain the evidence,
duties, technologies, metrics and dates of compressed jobs.

Separate tasks from results. Use clear noun phrases for tasks and past-tense verbs
for results. Preserve personal, team and organization credit, numbers, limits,
units, qualifiers and uncertainty. Do not attach global skills or career-wide
achievements to a job without supporting source evidence.

Correct clear spelling and casing errors, remove empty bullets, join broken lines
and deduplicate repeated claims. Keep uncertain acronyms without inventing an
expansion. Keep uncommon tools in the appropriate authored text and evidence.

Choose at most eight eligible focus technologies with catalog logos in relevance
to recent work. Fewer are fine. Keep other technologies in skills and evidence.
Suggest readable semantic technology groups ordered by role relevance: principal
languages/platforms, frameworks, data stores, messaging, infrastructure and tools.
Exposure is approximate and based only on supported dated work with overlapping
intervals merged. Never invent duration for global skills, undated work or ongoing
periods without an explicit source observation date.

Include education, certifications, location and languages only when supported.
Do not expand an institution or degree from a layout reference. Leave unknown fields empty;
internal gaps, conflicts and warnings stay outside public resume text.

## Preset: shorten

Сократи выбранный текст. Убери повторы и лишние слова. Сохрани все факты,
числа, единицы, оговорки и личный или командный вклад. Не добавляй новые сведения.

## Preset: clarify

Напиши выбранный текст яснее. Используй простые и точные формулировки.
Сохрани факты, числа, единицы, оговорки и личный или командный вклад.
Не добавляй новые сведения.
